ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, We sent Nuh to his people, 'Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner.'

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.translation_en: 'That you worship Allah and fear Him and obey me.'

ayahs.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى
ayahs.translation_en: 'He will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'My Lord, indeed I invited my people night and day.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'But my invitation increased them not except in flight.'

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: 'And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments.'

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'Then I announced to them and confided to them privately.'

ayahs.arabic: وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And he constructed the ship, and whenever the chiefs of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him.

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
ayahs.translation_en: And I said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.'

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'He will send rain from the sky upon you in showers.'

ayahs.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.'

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'What is wrong with you that you do not attribute to Allah dignity?'

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ
ayahs.translation_en: Until, when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, 'Load upon it of each creature two mates.'

ayahs.arabic: وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Nuh called out to his son.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَآوِي إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water.' He said, 'There is no protector today from the command of Allah, except whom He has had mercy upon.'

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ
ayahs.translation_en: And it was said, 'O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold your rain.' And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ
ayahs.translation_en: And Nuh called to his Lord and said, 'My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا نُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ ۖ فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O Nuh, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is one whose work was other than righteous. So do not ask Me about that of which you have no knowledge.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.'
